comment: Feature not offered: the profile scope releases name and preferred_username only. The deployment holds no picture, birthdate, locale and so on (data minimisation, docs/specs/m4-sign-in.md).
Feature not offered: the claims request parameter. Claims come from scopes only; the module asks for name through the claims parameter with scope openid alone.
Feature not offered: acr values. Sign-in has one level (GitHub); step-up is a separate passkey check on /v1, not an acr.
